title: Desire
subtitle: 「願望／渴望／慾望」，究竟是哪一種 desire？
description: 「願望／渴望／慾望」，究竟是哪一種 desire？

words.note: 最常見、最直接的近義詞之一，表示想要某事發生，強度通常比 desire 弱，也較日常。
words.example: Her greatest wish is to see her family reunited.
words.exampleZh: 她最大的願望是看到家人團聚。

exercises.original: Her greatest desire is to see her family reunited.
exercises.zh: 她最大的願望是看到家人團聚。

options.explanation: 這是個人希望某件事發生的自然日常說法，greatest wish 很常見。
通常偏長期人生或職業目標；家庭團聚更像 wish。
用於強烈感官／成癮式渴求，不適合家庭團聚。
表示突然想做某事，不是持久願望。
多用於食慾或比喻性需求，不合。

exercises.original: His main desire was simply to live a peaceful life.
exercises.zh: 他最大的願望只是過平靜生活。

options.explanation: peaceful life 是個人願望，語氣自然溫和。
「平靜生活」通常不是成就導向的 ambition。
只是傾向／意願，沒有「最大的願望」意味。

exercises.original: She expressed a desire for everyone to remain safe.
exercises.zh: 她表達希望大家平安。

options.explanation: express a wish for... 是標準搭配，表示希望某結果發生。

words.note: 表示較長期、向上或人生方向性的願望，常與事業、教育、成就有關。
words.example: Becoming a doctor had been her childhood aspiration.
words.exampleZh: 成為醫生一直是她童年的志向。

exercises.original: Her childhood desire was to become a surgeon.
exercises.zh: 她童年的志向是成為外科醫生。

options.explanation: career goal + childhood long-term aim 是 aspiration 的典型語境。
可以，但太一般，沒有長期人生目標感。

exercises.original: The programme helps students turn their educational desires into realistic plans.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃幫助學生把教育志向變成實際計劃。

options.explanation: educational aspirations 是固定高頻搭配。
短期衝動，不合長期規劃。
熱情不等於具體教育目標。

exercises.original: Many young employees have a desire to move into leadership roles.
exercises.zh: 很多年輕員工都有晉身領導職位的抱負。

options.explanation: leadership role 是 career development 目標，屬長期抱負。
可表示強烈嚮往，但不如 aspiration 專業。

words.note: 表示強烈、持久而帶情感的渴望，常用於人、家鄉、平靜生活或難以得到的東西。
words.example: He felt a deep longing for home.

exercises.original: He felt a strong desire to return home after many years abroad.
exercises.zh: 在海外多年後，他強烈思念並渴望回家。

options.explanation: home + many years abroad 是情感持續性的典型線索。

exercises.original: The novel is filled with a desire for a simpler life.
exercises.zh: 這部小說充滿對更簡單生活的深切嚮往。

options.explanation: 文學作品 + simpler life 的深切嚮往，非常適合 longing。
過於口語，不適合作名詞抽象文學表達。

exercises.original: She spoke about her desire for the mountains of her childhood.
exercises.zh: 她談到自己對童年山區的思念。

options.explanation: childhood place + emotional memory 是典型 longing for。

words.note: 與 longing 很接近，但更有持續、內心深處的渴望感，語氣較文學。
words.example: She had a strong yearning for independence.

exercises.original: She had a deep desire for independence.
exercises.zh: 她深切渴望獨立。

options.explanation: deep + independence 表示持續而內在的強烈嚮往。
可有目標意味，但不如 yearning 表達內心情感。

exercises.original: The poem expresses a powerful desire for freedom.
exercises.zh: 這首詩表達對自由的強烈渴望。

options.explanation: poem + powerful + freedom 是文學化深層渴望語境。

exercises.original: He never lost his desire for a life closer to nature.
exercises.zh: 他一直沒有失去對更貼近自然生活的嚮往。

options.explanation: never lost 顯示持久渴望。

words.note: 表示想取得成就、地位或影響力的強烈願望。比 aspiration 更帶競爭性和成就導向。
words.example: His ambition is to lead the company one day.
words.exampleZh: 他的抱負是有一天領導公司。

exercises.original: His main desire is to become chief executive one day.
exercises.zh: 他的主要抱負是有一天成為行政總裁。

options.explanation: high-status career goal 是 ambition 的典型語境。
情感化，不夠職業成就導向。
可用但力度／成就感較弱。

exercises.original: Her desire to build an international business grew stronger every year.
exercises.zh: 她建立國際企業的雄心逐年增強。

options.explanation: building an international business 是成就導向的長期企圖。
可說 appetite for growth，但不是此結構。

exercises.original: Political office was never one of his personal desires.
exercises.zh: 從政從來不是他的個人抱負之一。

options.explanation: political office 作為人生／地位目標，最自然用 ambition。

words.note: 表示希望某件事成真，通常比 desire 更偏向「期待結果」，未必包含強烈主觀慾求。
words.example: There is still hope that the negotiations will succeed.

exercises.original: There is a strong desire that the talks will succeed.
exercises.zh: 人們強烈希望談判成功。

options.explanation: that the talks will succeed 是對結果的期待，最自然是 hope。

exercises.original: The rescue team still has a desire to find survivors alive.
exercises.zh: 救援隊仍希望找到生還者。

options.explanation: 結果尚未確定，重點是期待好結果。

exercises.original: Their desire is that inflation will continue to fall.
exercises.zh: 他們期望通脹繼續下降。

options.explanation: macroeconomic outcome expected in future，用 hope 最自然。

words.note: 表示非常強烈、近乎難以抗拒的需要，常用於食物、飲品、尼古丁或某種感官／心理需求。
words.example: She had a sudden craving for chocolate.

exercises.original: She suddenly felt a strong desire for chocolate.
exercises.zh: 她突然非常想吃朱古力。
exercises.upgrade: craving · 強烈渴求；強烈慾望

options.explanation: sudden + specific food 是 craving 的典型語境。

exercises.original: After quitting smoking, he experienced a powerful desire for nicotine.
exercises.zh: 戒煙後，他強烈渴求尼古丁。

options.explanation: nicotine + quitting 是典型 addiction craving 語境。

exercises.original: The long hike gave everyone a strong desire for cold water.
exercises.zh: 長途遠足令大家非常渴望冷水。

options.explanation: specific physical need after exertion，craving 很自然。

words.note: 表示突然想做某事的內在衝動，通常短期而直接。
words.example: He resisted the urge to check his phone.
words.exampleZh: 他忍住了查看手機的衝動。

exercises.original: He felt a sudden desire to leave the room immediately.
exercises.zh: 他突然有立即離開房間的衝動。

options.explanation: sudden + action to leave 是 immediate impulse。

exercises.original: She resisted the desire to check her phone during the meeting.
exercises.zh: 她忍住了會議期間查看手機的衝動。

options.explanation: resist the urge to... 是固定高頻搭配。

exercises.original: He had a desire to interrupt, but he stayed silent.
exercises.zh: 他很想打斷對方，但仍保持沉默。

options.explanation: 短時動作衝動 + resisted action，最適合 urge。

words.note: 最日常、最普通的說法，表示想得到某物或想做某事。強度比 desire 通常更弱、更口語。
words.example: I want a quieter place to work.
words.exampleZh: 我想要一個更安靜的工作地方。

exercises.original: I have a desire for a quieter place to work.
exercises.zh: 我想要一個更安靜的工作地方。

options.explanation: 日常直接表達想要某物，want 最自然。
長期目標，不是普通偏好。

exercises.original: She expressed a desire to leave early.
exercises.zh: 她表示想早點離開。

options.explanation: 普通日常意願，不需要更強烈詞。

exercises.original: Their desire is to reduce costs without cutting staff.
exercises.zh: 他們想在不裁員的情況下降低成本。

options.explanation: 一般商業目標，可簡單用 want to。
如果是長期宏大目標可用，但本句只是一般意圖。

words.note: 表示內在傾向或有點想做某事，不一定很強。
words.example: She had little inclination to continue the argument.
words.exampleZh: 她沒有太大意願繼續爭論。

exercises.original: She had little desire to continue the argument.
exercises.zh: 她沒有太大意願繼續爭論。

options.explanation: little inclination to do 是固定正式搭配，表示不太想做。

exercises.original: He showed no real desire to join the committee.
exercises.zh: 他沒有真正意願加入委員會。

options.explanation: 意願程度不高時，inclination 很自然。

exercises.original: She had a slight desire to accept the offer but remained uncertain.
exercises.zh: 她稍微傾向接受提議，但仍不確定。

words.note: 除了食慾，也可比喻對風險、投資、權力、資訊等的「胃口／需求」。
words.example: Investor appetite for risk has increased.
words.exampleZh: 投資者承擔風險的意願增加。

exercises.original: Investors showed a growing desire for riskier assets.
exercises.zh: 投資者對較高風險資產的風險胃口上升。

options.explanation: appetite for risk 是金融語境固定搭配。

exercises.original: Consumer desire for streaming content continues to grow.
exercises.zh: 消費者對串流內容的需求持續增加。

options.explanation: market language 中 consumer appetite for 很自然，表示需求／興趣。
不如 appetite 表達市場需求。

exercises.original: The company has little desire for further expansion this year.
exercises.zh: 公司今年對進一步擴張的意願不高。

options.explanation: appetite for expansion/risk/acquisitions 是商業比喻常見搭配。
可以，但不如 appetite 商業化。

words.note: 表示對某活動、理念或目標有強烈而持久的熱愛與投入；與 desire 重疊於「強烈想做／追求」。
words.example: Her passion for music shaped her career.
words.exampleZh: 她對音樂的熱情塑造了她的職業生涯。

exercises.original: Her desire for music shaped every major decision in her career.
exercises.zh: 她對音樂的熱情影響了職業生涯中的每個重大決定。

options.explanation: music + long-term life influence 是 passion 的典型語境。

exercises.original: His desire for teaching kept him in the profession for forty years.
exercises.zh: 他對教學的熱愛令他在這個行業工作四十年。

options.explanation: forty years 顯示持久投入與熱愛。

exercises.original: She spoke with great desire about protecting historic buildings.
exercises.zh: 她談到保護歷史建築時充滿熱情。

options.explanation: speak with passion about 是自然固定搭配，表示強烈投入和熱情。

words.note: 表示很想開始、參與或得到某事，常帶積極、迫不及待意味。
words.example: The students showed great eagerness to begin the project.
words.exampleZh: 學生非常渴望開始這個項目。

exercises.original: The students showed a strong desire to begin the new project.
exercises.zh: 學生非常渴望開始新項目。
exercises.upgrade: eagerness · 渴望；熱切；迫切期待

options.explanation: eagerness to begin 表示積極、迫不及待開始。
較深層情感，通常不是開始項目的積極興奮。

exercises.original: Her desire to learn was obvious from the number of questions she asked.
exercises.zh: 她熱切學習的態度從她提出大量問題可見一斑。

options.explanation: 大量提問顯示積極參與和熱切學習。
雖可比喻 appetite for knowledge，但 eagerness to learn 更直接。

exercises.original: The volunteers expressed a strong desire to help immediately.
exercises.zh: 志願者表達了立即幫忙的熱切意願。

options.explanation: help immediately + volunteers 表示積極、迫切投入。

words.note: 較文學、帶感情色彩，表示一個人最深切、最珍視的願望。
words.example: Travelling the world had always been her heart's desire.
words.exampleZh: 環遊世界一直是她心中最深的願望。

exercises.original: Travelling the world had always been her deepest desire.
exercises.zh: 環遊世界一直是她心中最深的願望。
exercises.upgrade: heart's desire · 心中最深的願望；夙願

options.explanation: deepest desire + lifelong cherished wish 對應文學常見表達。
可作人生目標，但沒有珍視、深層願望色彩。

exercises.original: Owning a small bookstore was his greatest desire.
exercises.zh: 擁有一間小書店是他最大的夙願。

options.explanation: greatest desire + cherished personal dream，最合適。
可表希望，但缺少最深願望的情感力度。

exercises.original: Her deepest desire was to see peace return to the region.
exercises.zh: 她心中最深的願望是看到該地區恢復和平。
exercises.upgrade: heart's desire · 心中最深的願望

options.explanation: deepest desire 是直接語義線索。
是熱情，不等於願望內容。

falseSynonyms.zh: wish 可以只是希望某事成真；desire 往往更強、更正式或更具內在驅動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I wish I had more free time. She has a strong desire to become independent.

falseSynonyms.zh: aspiration 常是人生、教育或事業目標；desire 可以是短期、感官或情感慾望。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His aspiration is to become a researcher. His desire for coffee was immediate.

falseSynonyms.zh: longing 常用於思念、家鄉、愛情或難以得到的生活狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She had a desire to improve her skills. She felt a deep longing for home.

falseSynonyms.zh: craving 通常是強烈而迫切的需要，常見於食物、飲料、成癮物質。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He has a desire to travel more. He had a sudden craving for sugar.

falseSynonyms.zh: ambition 通常和事業、權力、成就有關；desire 範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She has a desire for a quieter life. She has the ambition to run her own company.

falseSynonyms.zh: urge 多指突然想做某動作；desire 可以長期存在。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He has a long-term desire to study abroad. He felt an urge to leave immediately.

falseSynonyms.zh: passion 是強烈熱愛和投入，通常比 desire 更偏情感與身份認同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She has a desire to learn Spanish. She has a passion for languages.

falseSynonyms.zh: desire 是名詞或動詞；desirable 是形容詞，表示值得擁有／令人想要。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He has a strong desire for change. A flexible schedule is highly desirable.
